circuits.detail: County extension agent positions unfilled leaving farmers without local research translation
Technology transfer from lab to field stalling without demonstration sites and farmer training

Field trial results not reaching practitioners through effective communication channels

Research station sites not representing the diversity of soil and climate conditions in production areas
